The <b>Craw Memento</b> is a [[Materium#Mementos|Memento]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==

The memento can be displayed on a shelf in the [[Bellhome]] after interacting with the desk.

It appears in the bottom-right slot of the shelving.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Bellhome.png!Location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Bellhart 09.png!Displayed inside Bellhome in Bellhart
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Awarded after defeating the [[Crawfather]] in the [[Greymoor#Court of Craws|Court of Craws]].
